description: This file contains functions for parsing and modifying boot configuration files, including validating magic numbers, reading partition information, and toggling the primary boot partition.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Validates the magic numbers at the start and end of a boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of partitions defined in the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Finds the index of a partition given its name.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Gets the current primary boot partition index for a given partition.

methods.name: _set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot flag (0 or 1) for a specific partition.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Public interface to set the primary boot flag for a partition, with validation.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot flag between 0 and 1 for a partition.
